instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Industrial bakery producing frozen dough and par-baked products for supermarket chains and food service distributors. Output of 15,000 units per day across 4 production lines. Key challenges are shelf-life extension through modified atmosphere packaging and reducing energy consumption in blast freezing. Multi-department organization with formalized budgets, quarterly business reviews, and a dedicated strategy function.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm. We run quarterly hackathons focused on process optimization, maintain a formal patent portfolio for packaging solutions, and have a rotating 'innovation fellow' program where high-potential employees spend 6 months dedicated to exploratory projects. Our last hackathon produced a prototype for automated quality inspection using computer vision that is now in production, reducing defect escape rate by 35%.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring subscription services for food service clients, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion tailored to regional distributors.
answers.additionalContext: The company operates in a geographically fragmented market where local supply chain dynamics significantly impact pricing and distribution. Current competitive advantages lie primarily in product consistency and localized service quality rather than large-scale operational scale.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

opportunities.title: Optimized Energy Consumption via Predictive Scheduling
opportunities.rationale: Implementing machine learning models to predict demand spikes in the freezing process will allow for dynamic energy load shifting. This incremental change directly addresses operational cost concerns and aligns with efficiency goals without requiring massive infrastructure overhaul.

first_actions: Pilot ML model on one production line's energy data
Establish baseline KPI for kWh per unit produced
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of 10% in average energy consumption during peak freezing hours within Q3.
milestones: Pilot deployment and initial savings report (Month 5)

opportunities.title: Direct-to-Business Subscription 'Freshness Guarantee' Platform
opportunities.rationale: Pivot the product offering from transactional sales to a recurring subscription service for key food service chains. This radical shift creates stable, predictable revenue streams and locks in customer relationships through guaranteed freshness metrics.

first_actions: Develop a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) subscription dashboard
Conduct market research on existing subscription models for regional distributors
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 5 pilot contracts generating $150k in annualized recurring revenue within 12 months.

opportunities.title: Automated Quality Control Expansion (Line 3)
opportunities.rationale: Expand the successful computer vision system to two additional production lines. This incremental scaling leverages existing R&D success and directly improves product quality consistency, reducing waste and potential recalls.

first_actions: Allocate resources from the 'innovation fellow' budget
Integrate new vision system into Line 3 SOPs
execution_plan.success_metric: Defect escape rate reduction from 35% to <20% across all lines within 9 months.

next_steps.action: Form a cross-functional task force (Operations + Strategy) to finalize the business case for the 'Freshness Guarantee' subscription model.
Allocate the remaining budget portion (€10k) to procure necessary hardware and secure initial consulting for the energy optimization pilot.
Audit current project management 'process' bottlenecks identified in the strategic review and propose standardized sprint rituals across all business units.

key_weaknesses: Inconsistent execution velocity between business units, leading to siloed innovation efforts.
Over-reliance on a formal process structure which may stifle the rapid iteration needed for growth initiatives.
Limited budget allocation (10%) severely restricts the scale and speed of high-impact radical projects.
Cultural inertia regarding adopting new digital tools outside core systems, posing a barrier to broader innovation adoption.
